name: Village on Sage Street
operator: Volunteers of America Northern California & Northern Nevada (partners: Community Foundation of Northern Nevada, City of Reno)
population: Single adults 18+ with low income (dorm-style single-occupancy; income range reported $1,320-$2,735/mo gross)
how_to_apply: Direct application to VOA; background check; income limits
waitlist_status: City memo: consistently full with a queue of eligible applicants
status: open (since July 2019); 96-unit expansion proposed in City memo, completion not verified
notes: Not formal HUD-defined PSH: low-barrier affordable modular dorm units, $400/mo rent + $400 deposit (reported). Listed here per scope. Verify current rent/units.

name: Hi-Way 40 (Highway 40) supportive housing
operator: Volunteers of America Northern California & Northern Nevada (owner since 9/15/2023); partners City of Reno, Northern Nevada Adult Mental Health Services
population: Extremely/very low income adults (<=60% AMI) with preference for people with mental health needs
how_to_apply: Likely referral-based (CES / NNAMHS); not confirmed
funding_source: Home Means Nevada, Nevada Attainable Housing Account, City of Reno; ~$1.5M supportive-services awards (case management, peer support)
status: converted motel; occupancy plans presented to Washoe County May 2026 (lease-up 2026, verify)
notes: Unit count changed over time: 35 motel rooms (2022), 22 units (City page), 28 furnished units (21 studios, 6 one-BR + manager unit) per May 2026 county meeting. City page had projected Fall 2024 completion.

name: Line Drive Apartments
operator: Accessible Space, Inc. (ASI); builder Metcalf Builders; architect Creative Design Architecture
population: Veterans and people with disabilities, incl. people experiencing homelessness with physical disabilities
how_to_apply: Contact ASI; PSH units likely filled via VA/RHA/CES referral (not confirmed)
funding_source: ~$15M; partners Nevada Housing Division, Washoe County, VA, Reno Housing Authority, Washoe County HOME Consortium
status: open - grand opening May 12, 2026 (broke ground Feb 2025)
notes: 3-story; 24-hour on-site staff per ASI. This is the 'Line Dr PSH project' - it is ASI's, not RHA/CSH/Silver Sage.

name: Nevada Cares Campus Permanent Supportive Housing
operator: Washoe County Housing & Homeless Services (campus operator VOA)
population: Chronically homeless / people exiting homelessness (single adults)
address: Nevada Cares Campus, E. Fourth St (verify exact address)
how_to_apply: CES referral only: Community Housing Assessment Tool (CHAT) assessment via Northern Nevada CoC Coordinated Entry (most assessments at Nevada Cares Campus); Washoe County Housing & Homeless Services 775-325-8210
funding_source: $21.9M Home Means Nevada grant + $5.6M Supportive Housing Development Fund
notes: 50 studios with kitchen/bath; onsite case management. Name 'Cares Campus Apartments' not confirmed as official name.

name: Our Place (Washoe County) - PSH component
how_to_apply: CES referral only: Community Housing Assessment Tool (CHAT) assessment via Northern Nevada CoC Coordinated Entry (most assessments at Nevada Cares Campus); Washoe County Housing & Homeless Services 775-325-8210
status: unverified - only shelter capacity confirmed (38-room family shelter, 102-bed women's shelter)
notes: Could not confirm a PSH component at Our Place; treat as shelter until verified.

name: Hope Landing
operator: Reno Housing Authority (owner/operator); Volunteers of America (supportive services)
population: People exiting homelessness / most vulnerable (chronically homeless focus reported by media, not confirmed by RHA)
address: Reported at Sutro St & Carville Dr (former Carville Court site) - verify
how_to_apply: Project-based vouchers; expected CES/partner referral
funding_source: Nevada Housing Division HOME-ARP, RHA Moving to Work fungibility, deferred developer fees; FHLBank SF AHP $600,000 (Aug 2026)
status: under construction - groundbreaking late May 2026; opening expected spring 2027
notes: Trauma-informed design based on Dick Scott Manor lessons.

name: Carville Court (redevelopment)
how_to_apply: Applications at RHA, 1525 E. 9th St
funding_source: National Housing Trust Fund $1,732,161.33 via Nevada Housing Division (accepted Aug 2025); ~$5M new construction
status: redevelopment - likely the same site/project as Hope Landing (under construction)
notes: 2023 RHA overview listed 6 units; 2024 county presentation listed 11 PSH units/$5M new construction. Media later placed Hope Landing (15 units) on the former Carville Court site - probably one project; dedupe with Hope Landing.

name: Dick Scott Manor
operator: Reno Housing Authority; case management by VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System
how_to_apply: VA referral (project-based HUD-VASH)
notes: 4 studios + 8 one-bedrooms; RHA's first PSH development.

name: Sierra Manor I & II
operator: Volunteers of America (per Washoe County resource guide - verify)
how_to_apply: Direct application at property (HUD rent 30% of income)
funding_source: HUD Section 202 direct loan with Section 8 assistance
notes: DETERMINATION: Sierra Manor is HUD senior/disabled housing (Section 202/8), NOT PSH and NOT transitional. Sierra Manor I = 145 units (some sources 147); Sierra Manor II added 2013 bringing site to 187 HUD units.

name: Washoe Mill Apartments
how_to_apply: Direct application/waitlist form at property
funding_source: HUD 221(d)(4) + Section 8 per HUD index (one directory says Section 202)
notes: Studios & 1BR. Alt phone (775) 323-4399 in county brochure. Low 2015 REAC score (62).

name: Carville Park Apartments
operator: Northern Nevada Building & Construction Trades Council Development Corp. (rehab developer, with AFL-CIO Housing Investment Trust)
how_to_apply: Direct application at property
status: open; full gut rehab broke ground Oct 29, 2024 (first major renovation since 1978)
notes: Do not confuse with RHA's Carville Court.

name: Reno Silvercrest Residence
how_to_apply: Direct application at property
notes: 56 vs 57 units across sources; built ~1996; 1&2 BR.

name: Metropolitan Gardens Apartments
how_to_apply: Direct application at property (30% of income)

name: Golden I Apartments (Golden Apartments)
how_to_apply: Direct application/waitlist at property
waitlist_status: Accepting waitlist applications per Apartment Finder; likely long
notes: HUD index 100 units; ProPublica 159 HUD units (possibly Golden I+II).

name: William J. Raggio Plaza
how_to_apply: Online application via accessiblespace.org
notes: Voucher holders may have to give up HCV to move in (project-based subsidy).

name: John Butterworth Estates
population: People with disabilities (county brochure also lists seniors)
how_to_apply: Online application via accessiblespace.org
notes: 1&2 BR, wheelchair accessible units.

name: Centennial Park Annex
notes: Only aggregator listing found (38 Section 8 units, June 2025).

name: Nevada Section 811 Project Rental Assistance (PRA)
population: Extremely low-income persons with disabilities age 18-61; priority for people exiting institutions (Money Follows the Person)
how_to_apply: Referral through state partner agencies
notes: ~44 units statewide awarded 2015.

name: Mineral Manor
address: E. Ninth St area (RHA administrative offices at 1525 E. Ninth St are located at Mineral Manor)
how_to_apply: Direct application to RHA public housing waitlist (online portal / 1525 E. Ninth St); text RHARESIDENT to 888777 for waitlist alerts
waitlist_status: Public housing waitlists opened Nov 3, 2025 and listed as open until further notice (RHA; verify)
notes: RHA's first public housing (construction began 1958); ~140 families.

name: The Village at Hawk View (Hawk View Apartments redevelopment)
how_to_apply: RHA project-based waitlist for The Village at Hawk View (opened Apr 6, 2026)
status: under construction - Dec 2025 update targeted July 2026 completion; other reports say 2027; lease-up status unverified
notes: Replaces 100-unit 2BR public housing complex built 1984; 7 buildings with 1-3BR; converting to project-based assistance.

name: Silverada Manor
operator: Reno Housing Authority (master developer Brinshore Development)
how_to_apply: RHA Silverada Manor project-based waitlist
waitlist_status: Opened Nov 3, 2025 (open per RHA applicant page; verify)
funding_source: RAD/Section 18 conversion to Section 8 project-based; ~$70-74.5M rehab
status: under rehabilitation (phase 2 began Aug 2025; Dec 2025 update targeted July 2026); residents have right to return
notes: Built 1963; converting from public housing to PBV.

name: Tom Sawyer Village

waitlist_status: Public housing waitlists opened Nov 3, 2025 and listed as open until further notice (RHA; verify)
notes: Designed 1962; first senior public housing in northern Nevada.

waitlist_status: Public housing waitlists opened Nov 3, 2025 and listed as open until further notice (RHA; verify)
notes: 68 units per RHA (67 in 2017 HUD data). Built 1980s-90s.

waitlist_status: Public housing waitlists opened Nov 3, 2025 and listed as open until further notice (RHA; verify)
notes: Built 1980s-90s.

waitlist_status: Public housing waitlists opened Nov 3, 2025 and listed as open until further notice (RHA; verify)
notes: 104 units per 2017 HUD inspection data.

name: John McGraw Court

status: open - reopened after modernization (grand reopening Oct 3; year likely 2025)
notes: John McGraw + Silver Sage Courts total 50 units. One aggregator gives 2455 Orovada St (shared with Silver Sage Court) - unverified.

name: Silver Sage Court

name: Yorkshire Terrace

notes: SUBTYPE: RHA community-benefit / PBV property. Details unverified.

name: Pilgrims Rest (project-based)
how_to_apply: RHA Pilgrims Rest project-based waitlist
notes: Owner not verified.

name: RHA Reno Avenue development
address: 440 Reno Ave (between Reno Ave and W. Taylor St)
status: planned - City of Reno pre-application meeting June 29, 2026
notes: SUBTYPE: RHA affordable new construction (4 buildings, 1&2BR). 440 Reno Ave also currently RHA Resident Services office.

name: Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) - Reno Housing Authority
operator: Reno Housing Authority (Moving to Work agency)
how_to_apply: Online waitlist application only when open; text RHARESIDENT to 888777 for alerts
waitlist_status: CLOSED (as of latest RHA applicant page and Nov 2025 announcement; FY2026 MTW report says HCV list did not open during FY2026)
notes: Voucher count varies by doc: ~3,110 (older) vs 2,638 HCV (board packet). Preferences include elderly, disabled, homeless, veterans, local residency. Absorbing EHV holders could reduce new issuance.

name: RHA Public Housing & Project-Based Assistance waitlists
how_to_apply: Direct application to RHA public housing waitlist (online portal / 1525 E. Ninth St); text RHARESIDENT to 888777 for waitlist alerts
waitlist_status: OPEN: all public housing sites, general project-based, Silverada Manor, Pilgrims Rest (opened Nov 3, 2025); Village at Hawk View PBV (opened Apr 6, 2026)
notes: ~690-751 public housing units in 8 complexes (Essex Manor, Mineral Manor, John McGraw Court, Myra Birch Manor, Silverada Manor, Tom Sawyer Village, Stead Manor, Hawk View); 5 family, 3 senior/disabled. Preference for applicants completing Washoe County PSH programs.

name: HUD-VASH (Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing) - RHA
operator: Reno Housing Authority + VA Sierra Nevada Health Care System
how_to_apply: VA referral only (mandatory VA case management)
notes: Allocation 593 (Jan 2026 board packet), 147 project-based (incl. Dick Scott Manor); earlier counts 411 (2023), 498. +52 vouchers in 2024 award.

name: Emergency Housing Vouchers (EHV) - RHA
population: People experiencing or at risk of homelessness, fleeing DV, trafficking
how_to_apply: No new issuance - HUD stopped issuing new EHVs Apr 9, 2026
funding_source: HUD EHV (ARPA); funding reported through Dec 31, 2026
status: winding down - 82 active as of June 30, 2026 (137 originally awarded); RHA exploring absorbing into HCV
notes: Funding cliff risk after Dec 2026; absorption into HCV would reduce new HCV issuance.

name: Foster Youth to Independence (FYI) / foster youth vouchers - RHA
operator: Reno Housing Authority; case management by Eddy House and Washoe County Human Services Agency
how_to_apply: Partner referral (Washoe County HSA / Eddy House)
funding_source: HUD FYI (program name not fully confirmed)

name: RHA Project-Based Vouchers (special populations)
how_to_apply: Property-specific PBV waitlists or partner referral
notes: 294 PBV units total, 102 at RHA-owned properties (board packet; earlier figure 144).

name: Washoe County rapid rehousing / housing navigation via Coordinated Entry
operator: Washoe County Housing & Homeless Services and CoC-funded partners
how_to_apply: CES referral only: Community Housing Assessment Tool (CHAT) assessment via Northern Nevada CoC Coordinated Entry (most assessments at Nevada Cares Campus); Washoe County Housing & Homeless Services 775-325-8210
status: active; county TSSS program (ARPA) housed 47 people as of 9/15/2025 and was to wrap up Nov 2026
notes: Specific RRH providers/slot counts not verified. Catholic Charities is a CES entry point.

name: HOPWA / Northern Nevada HOPES housing assistance
operator: Northern Nevada HOPES (dated); state DPBH Ryan White/HOPWA
how_to_apply: Through HIV case management (HOPES)
notes: Only a 2016 DPBH provider list confirms HOPES housing services (rent/utility help). No current Washoe HOPWA details found.

name: Catholic Charities of Northern Nevada - PSH intake
population: Homeless individuals/families eligible for CoC PSH
how_to_apply: Intake/assessment by Catholic Charities (per Washoe HSA resource guide)
notes: Washoe HSA guide says Catholic Charities provides intake and assessment for all its PSH programs. Crossroads/Battle Born Housing Plus are sober-living/transitional, not PSH.
